subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should native subagent completion routing become a supported sessions_spawn contract, and should that contract include global and per-agent configuration defaults?
rationale: Source review can establish correctness, but it cannot decide whether OpenClaw should permanently support this new orchestration policy and configuration surface or intentionally keep completion routing implicit.

options.title: Sponsor per-spawn routing first
options.body: Accept announceTarget on sessions_spawn with durable restart behavior, but remove the global and per-agent defaults until broader policy is explicitly approved.

options.title: Sponsor the full surface
options.body: Accept the proposed per-call, per-agent, and global configuration contract together with its fail-closed parent-delivery semantics.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Decline the new core contract and continue using existing explicit callback or workflow mechanisms for orchestrator handoff.

recommendation.title: Sponsor per-spawn routing first
recommendation.body: Accept announceTarget on sessions_spawn with durable restart behavior, but remove the global and per-agent defaults until broader policy is explicitly approved.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available product-routing candidate from recent session-tool and subagent-area history.
